manifest_snapshot.description:
Ask Loop Engineering Agent: 1. Perfect example.jpg (Lodgify SaaS):
   • Clean airy light theme with emerald / lime-green primary accents (#10B981 / #84CC16)
   • Top executive metric cards ($123,980, 840, 231) with green percentage growth pills (+15%)
   • Smooth area gradient charts for applicant volume & donut charts for sourcing breakdown
   • Structured data tables with rounded badge tags, avatar chips, and action icons (Download, View, Edit)
   • Right-side drawer for candidate profile details & messaging stream

2. Team Dashboard.jpg (Taskify):
   • High-density modular grid with circular donut progress rings (68% Complete)
   • Multi-stage horizontal timeline bars (Sourcing -> Screening -> Interview -> Offer)
   • Filterable calendar agenda & goal tracker bars

3. Employees.jpg (SmartHR):
   • Sleek collapsible left sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Applications, Candidates, Interviews, Settings)
   • Header search bar with profile avatar and quick action notification bell
   • Tabbed candidate detail views (Overview, Skills Scorecard, Interview Notes, Documents)
